paragraphs: From Westside Galway test centre, depart to the right onto Bóthar Le Cheile and follow it for about 280 metres
At the end of the road turn left onto Siobhan McKenna Road, then at the next end of road turn left onto Circular Road
At the following end of road turn right onto Rahoon Road, which continues straight ahead as Bishop O'Donnell Road
At the first roundabout take the exit for Western Distributor Road, bearing left, and stay on the Western Distributor for a good stretch

You will pass through a series of roundabouts here, so keep in your lane, check mirrors early, and follow the signs for the Western Distributor Road each time, taking the slight left or straight exit as the road continues
At the next roundabout take the slight left onto Cappagh Road and pull in safely to complete the first stop
Move off again from Cappagh Road and continue for around 700 metres, then at the end of the road turn left onto Barna Road
Follow Barna Road take the 1st right onto Upper Salthill Road
After Upper Salthill Road turn left onto Threadneedle Road

Take the 1st right onto Doctor Mannix Road turn left into D'Alton Drive to complete a short residential section, then move off again and retrace: right back onto Doctor Mannix Road, and at the end of the road turn right onto Threadneedle Road
Threadneedle Road continues straight onto Bishop O'Donnell Road
At the roundabout take the slight left to stay on Bishop O'Donnell Road, which then becomes Rahoon Road and then Seamus Quirke Road
Turn left onto Bóthar Le Cheile for a brief stop near the test centre

To finish, depart Bóthar Le Cheile again and repeat the earlier sequence: left onto Siobhan McKenna Road, left onto Circular Road, right onto Rahoon Road, straight onto Bishop O'Donnell Road, and back out along the Western Distributor Road through the roundabouts

On the return leg take the 1st right onto Binn Bhán, then at the end of the road turn right onto Luí na Gréine and pull in on the left, heading back toward the Westside Galway test centre to end the route
